title: Probe
text: Output signal attributes, including width, dimensionality, sample time, and complex signal flag, 1 input, 4 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Data type for signal complexity} sets Data type of complexity output; {Probe width} sets the output width of the input signal, {Probe sample time} sets the output sample time of input signal, {Detect complex signal} indicates the complexity of input signal, {Probe signal dimensions} sets the output dimensions of input signal, {Data type for width} sets the data type of signal width, {Data type for sample time} sets the data type of sample time and {Data type for signal dimensions} sets the data type for signal dimension output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Input signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Probe width
params.values: Output width of the input signal on (default) | off

params.name: Probe sample time
params.values: Output sample time of input signal on (default) | off

params.name: Detect complex signal
params.values: Indicate the complexity of input signal on (default) | off

params.name: Probe signal dimensions
params.values: Output dimensions of input signal on (default) | off

params.name: Data type for width
params.values: Data type of signal width output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | Same as input

params.name: Data type for sample time
params.values: Data type of sample time output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | Same as input

params.name: Data type for signal complexity
params.values: Data type of complexity output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean | Same as input

params.name: Data type for signal dimensions
params.values: Data type for signal dimension output double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | Same as input
